title: ~82 Days of Game Dev + AI
author: greatcoltini
selftext:
Hey guys! Wanted to share the progress of my game over the past few months - so I had Opus 5.5 create a nice comparison from the first build to the current state!

Used: 

* meshy for the 3d models
* CC 5.5Opus for the comparison videos
* Development used \~Opus, then Sol5.6 and Astra, now back to Opus
* SFX generated in python or free use assets
* Music generated with Suno

  
Would love to get people's thoughts on the development so far, and am happy to answer any questions.

comments.author: Pale-Factor242
comments.body: damn cool I too just started game dev with AI though i use Astra im still busy trying to figure out how to make better models i'll try meshy if it can get results like that.

replies.author: greatcoltini
replies.body:
Yeah! 

I think meshy is good, my workflow for it was to have Astra build the 2d rendering of the monster, then I would feed that into meshy messy generate the 3d models.

Not sure if it's the most optimal, and there is still work to be done to make things perfect. 

I definitely think meshy is significantly better than using Astra/Opus.
